rows.text_en: Ministry of Health and Welfare ( Senior Support Division ), 044-202-3478

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「대한노인회 지원에 관한 법률」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Support for the Korea Senior Citizens Association and matters necessary for its implementation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(지도ㆍ감독 시 관계 서류) ① 「대한노인회 지원에 관한 법률」 제9조제3항에서 “조사기간, 조사범위, 조사담당자, 관계 법령 등 보건복지부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 조사기간, 조사범위, 조사담당자, 관계 법령, 제출 자료, 유의사항 등을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Relevant Documents for Guidance and Supervision) ① In Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the Act on Support for the Korea Senior Citizens Association, “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, such as the investigation period, scope of investigation, person in charge of investigation, and relevant laws and regulations” refers to the investigation period, scope of investigation, person in charge of investigation, relevant laws and regulations, submitted materials, precautions, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 사항이 기재된 서류는 사회보장급여와 관련하여 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시하는 공통서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② Documents containing the matters under Paragraph 1 shall follow the common forms prescribed and notified by the Minister of Health and Welfare in relation to social security benefits.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Health and Welfare Decree No. 418, July 18, 2016>
This rule shall take effect on August 4, 2016.
